Had to turn my viral baked lasagne jacket into a tray bake for four … because one potato simply isn’t enough when comfort food calls 🥔😂 This is a take on my baked lasagne style jacket potato just bigger, better, and perfect for feeding four instead of one. Fluffy crispy jackets. Rich leftover Bolognese. Creamy cheesy béchamel. Finished with a golden cheese melt. Would you share this… or keep the whole tray to yourself? 👀 🥔 Lasagne-Style Jacket Potato Tray Bake Serves 4 Ingredients Jackets • 4 large baking potatoes • Olive oil spray • Sea salt & black pepper • 40g butter Filling • 600–700g leftover Bolognese sauce Cheesy Béchamel Sauce • 40g butter • 40g plain flour • 500ml semi-skimmed milk • Black pepper • 100g mixed grated cheese • 30–40g grated Parmesan For layering • 150–200g mozzarella or mixed cheese • Extra Parmesan for topping Method 1. Cook the jacket potatoes Pierce potatoes, rub with olive oil and salt. Air fry at 180°C for 45 minutes, then another 10 minutes until crispy. Oven option: 200°C for about 1 hour until fluffy inside and crunchy outside. 2. Make the cheesy béchamel Melt butter in a pan over medium heat. Stir in flour and cook for 1 minute. Gradually whisk in the milk until smooth and thickened. Season with black pepper, then stir through mixed cheese and Parmesan until melted and creamy. Set aside. 3. Assemble the tray bake Place all 4 crispy jackets into a large tray. Slice open and gently mash the centres with butter, salt and pepper. 👉 Spoon 1 tablespoon of béchamel into each potato and mix through the fluffy middle. Now layer in this order: • Add the leftover Bolognese • Pour over more béchamel sauce • Sprinkle over mozzarella or mixed cheese • Finish with a generous grating of Parmesan 4. Final melt Bake at 180°C for 10–12 minutes or air fry at 180°C for 4–5 minutes until golden, bubbling and irresistible. #foryoupagе #spud #jacketpotato #jacketpotatoes #lasagna

Ingredients: 1 tbsp salted butter 1 can (14oz)sweetened condensed milk  2/3 cup sweetened coconut flakes  Sugar coating: 1 cup granulated sugar 1/2 cup water 1 tbsp vinegar  How to: In a sauce pan add butter and turn it on medium heat until melted. Next add in sweetened condensed milk and coconut flakes. Stir on medium heat for 5-7 minutes until the mixture is thickened and can pull away from the pan. Add it into a separate bowl and place in the refrigerator until cooled.  Once cooled, take a tbsp of the mixture and roll it between greased hands to form a ball and place it onto a parchment lined pan until all of the mixture is formed into bite sized balls. Next in a sauce, pan, combine sugar, water, and vinegar. Bring to a boil, stirring occasionally, until it turns amber in color. Take off the heat. Next insert a toothpick into each ball and dip it into the amber sugar and place back onto a parchment lined pan.  Let cool and serve! #dessert #coconut #balabaiana #easyrecipe #recipeshare

Creamy Pesto Chicken Pasta Bake ✨ My most viral recipe of 2024!  What a year it’s been. I’m truly so grateful for all the love and support you’ve shown me this year. Cheers to a delicious 2025!  Here’s how to make it: 1lb pasta of choice 1/2 cup sun-dried tomatoes + oil 1lb chicken 1 tbsp butter 1/2 yellow onion, diced Salt and pepper, to taste 1 tsp red pepper flakes (to taste) 1 tsp smoked paprika (to taste) 1 tsp oregano (to taste) 6-8 cloves of garlic, minced (to taste) 2 cups heavy cream (room temp) 1-2 cups cooked broccoli  2 handfuls spinach 6-8 oz freshly shredded parmesan cheese (divided) 8 oz freshly shredded mozzarella (divided) 1/2 cup pesto, to taste (I recommend Costco brand) Parsley to garnish  1. Preheat oven to 350°F. Place the cream on the counter to come to room temp. 2. Boil your noodles in salted water a few minutes less than package instructions (al dente). Drain and set aside.  3. In a large oven-safe saucepan or dutch oven, heat 1 tbsp of sun-dried tomato oil over medium heat. Cook the chicken until it's no longer pink, then remove it from the pan and set it aside. Let it rest for a few minutes before cutting into bite-sized pieces. 4. In the same pan, melt the butter and add salt, pepper, red pepper, paprika, and oregano. Stir to toast, then toss in the onion and sauté for about 4 minutes. Add the garlic and cook for another 30 seconds. 5. Turn heat to low, pour in the heavy cream and stir. Let it simmer for a couple of minutes to thicken slightly. 6. Add half of the parmesan and 1 cup of mozzarella cheese,  stir until the cheese is melted. 7. Stir in the sun-dried tomatoes, cooked broccoli, spinach, chicken, cooked pasta, and pesto. 8. Top with the remaining mozzarella and parmesan cheese.  9. Bake at 350°F for 15 minutes, then broil for another 5 minutes, or until the top is golden and bubbly. 10. Sprinkle with fresh parsley, a little more parmesan, and enjoy! #pastabake #chickenpesto #pesto #pestopasta #pestochicken #pasta #pastarecipe #easyrecipe #easyrecipes #easymeal #easydinner #dinnerideas #dinner #foodtok #cooking

Warm the caramel sauce slightly and drizzle it generously over the top. 14. Sprinkle additional crispy rice cereal over the caramel. 15. Refrigerate for at least 1 hour until firm enough to slice. 16. Lift the dessert from the pan using the parchment paper and cut into neat squares. 17. MEATBALL SUB BITES! Homemade meatballs tossed in pizza sauce, then wrapped up in pizza dough with mozzarella and baked until golden brown, then brushed with butter, parm & parsley. And warm pizza sauce for dipping. It’s game day season and these are the perfect 2-bite app that we’re 100% sure everyone will love!!  Full recipe at: https://www.crowdedkitchen.com/meatball-sub-bites/ 1 lb 80/20 ground beef ½ cup Italian-seasoned breadcrumbs ½ cup whole milk 1 large egg ⅓ cup grated parmesan cheese 2 garlic cloves grated ¾ teaspoon kosher salt ½ teaspoon black pepper 8 ounces pizza dough 12 ounces pizza sauce divided ½ cup low-moisture mozzarella shredded 2 tablespoons melted butter for brushing Grated parmesan for topping Chopped parsley for topping Preheat your oven to 425˚F. To a small mixing bowl, add the breadcrumbs and milk together, stir, and let the mixture rest for five minutes. It should look like thick oatmeal, so add milk a tablespoon at a time if it looks dry. To a large mixing bowl, add the ground beef, panade, egg, parmesan, garlic, salt, and pepper. Mix gently by hand just until combined. Using a 3 tablespoon scoop, scoop into 14 meatballs and roll them into shape. Bake the meatballs 425°F for about 15 minutes. Slightly underbaked is fine; they'll be going back into the oven later. Toss the meatballs in about 4 ounces of the pizza sauce, setting the other half of the sauce aside for dipping later. They should be coated, not drenched. Cut the dough. Roll to ~12×10" and cut into squares. Grease a muffin tin. To make one of the meatball sub bites, add a square of pizza dough into one of the muffin slots, then place a pinch of shredded mozzarella on the bottom, a saucy meatball on top, and a pinch more mozzarella over it. Gather the corners over the top of the meatball, one at a time. Bake at 400°F for about 18-20 minutes, until deep golden and 160°F+ in the center. Brush with butter and parmesan before serving.

Sticky Chicken Tender, seasoned chicken coated in a sweet and savory sticky sauce, served over warm rice and finished with green onions and sesame seeds. Ingredients For the Chicken 1.5 lbs chicken breast, cut into bite-sized pieces 1 teaspoon each onion powder, garlic powder, and teaspoon salt ½ teaspoon each black pepper and paprika  2 tablespoons olive oil About ⅓ cup cornstarch Olive oil, for cooking For the Sticky Sauce ½ cup soy sauce ⅓ cup brown sugar or honey 1 tablespoon hoisin sauce 1 tablespoon ketchup 1 teaspoon ginger paste ½ tablespoon minced garlic 1 tablespoon cornstarch 2 tablespoons butter For Serving Cooked white rice Sliced green onions Sesame seeds Instructions 1. Add the chicken to a large bowl and season with onion powder, garlic powder, salt, black pepper, and paprika. Add 2 tablespoons of olive oil and toss until the chicken is evenly coated. 2. Sprinkle about ⅓ cup cornstarch over the seasoned chicken and toss until each piece is lightly and evenly coated. This helps give the chicken that tender, velvety texture and creates a great coating for the sauce. 3. In a bowl, whisk together the soy sauce, brown sugar or honey, hoisin sauce, ketchup, ginger paste, minced garlic, and 1½ tablespoons cornstarch until smooth. Set aside. 4. Heat a drizzle of olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Cook the chicken in 2 batches so you don't overcrowd the pan. Cook until golden brown on the outside and cooked through. Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside. 5. Reduce the heat and add 2 tablespoons of butter to the same skillet, scraping up all those flavorful browned bits from the bottom of the pan. 6. Pour the prepared sauce into the skillet. Cook over low heat, whisking frequently, until the sauce begins to bubble and thickens into a glossy, sticky consistency. 7. Add the cooked chicken back to the skillet and toss until every piece is completely coated in the sticky sauce. 8. Spoon the sticky chicken over warm rice and finish with sliced green onion.  #easyrecipe #dinnerideas #quickrecipes #easydinner #dinnerrecipes

STOP 🛑 everything you’re doing and make this 5-ingredient apple blender cake! 🍎 Link to all products used here https://www.amazon.com/shop/sivanskitchen/photo/amzn1.shoppablemedia.v1.45bca6da-246a-4a42-8bdb-f33a112f24c7?ref_=aipsfphoto Simple ingredients, minimal cleanup, and the result is the fluffiest, most delicious apple cake. Everything goes straight into the blender, and you’re done! Top it however you like, but melted Lotus Biscoff cookie butter with crushed pecans takes it to another level.  Bake in any pan of your choice✨ 5-INGREDIENT APPLE CAKE🍎 Ingredients • 1 medium-large apple, cut into chunks (I used Honeycrisp, but any apple works) • 3 large eggs • ¾ cup sugar (135 g) • ½ cup oil (120 ml) • 1½ cups self-rising flour (210 g) Optional: • 1 additional apple, peel on, cut into small chunks Flour Substitutions: • Gluten-free: 2 cups almond flour (180 g) + 1 tsp baking powder • All-purpose flour: 1½ cups (210 g) + 1 tsp baking powder For Topping: • Melted Biscoff cookie butter • Crushed pecans • Powdered sugar, optional Instructions 	1.	Wash and scrub the first apple. Peel if desired, then cut into chunks. 	2.	Add the apple, sugar, eggs and oil to a blender. Blend until completely smooth. 	3.	Add the flour and pulse only twice. Do not over-blend. Overmixing can make the cake dense instead of light and tender. 	4.	If using the additional apple, cut it into small chunks with the peel on and gently fold it into the finished batter. 	5.	Grease or spray your baking pan and pour in the batter. 	6.	Bake at 350°F (175°C) for about 45 minutes, depending on your pan. A toothpick inserted into the center should come out clean. 	7.	Allow to cool. Warm the Biscoff cookie butter until pourable, drizzle it over the cake and finish with crushed pecans. Freezes beautifully! 💛 Shana Tova umetukah🍯🐝 #sivanskitchen #easyrecipes #applecake #apple #holidays

videos.caption: This Banana Omelet Tastes Like French Toast 🍳 🍌 ⸻ Ingredients ▶️ 1 ripe banana (120 g) ▶️ 2 large eggs ▶️ 1/2 tsp ground cinnamon ▶️ 1/2 tsp vanilla powder ▶️ Small pinch of sea salt ▶️ 1 tsp butter or extra-virgin olive oil (for the pan) ⸻ Preparation 1. Peel the banana and mash it in a bowl until mostly smooth. 2. Add the eggs, cinnamon, vanilla powder, and sea salt. 3. Whisk until well combined. 4. Heat a non-stick skillet over medium-low heat and lightly grease it with the butter or olive oil. 5. Pour the mixture into the skillet and spread it into an even circle. 6. Cook for 3–4 minutes, until the bottom is golden and the top is mostly set. 7. Carefully flip the omelet with a wide spatula and cook for another 2–3 minutes, until fully cooked through. 8. Fold the omelet in half and serve warm. ⸻ Tips (For Best Results) 💡 Use a ripe banana: The riper the banana, the sweeter and more French toast-like the flavor. 💡 Cook over medium-low heat: This allows the eggs to cook through without burning the banana. 💡 Mash the banana well: A smoother mixture creates a more even texture. 💡 Use a non-stick skillet: It makes flipping much easier. 💡 Flip gently: Wait until the omelet is mostly set before turning it over. 💡 Customize the toppings: Serve with fresh berries, Greek yogurt, chopped nuts, or a drizzle of honey. 💡 Enjoy immediately: The texture is best while warm. ⸻ Nutrition (1 omelet) ✅ Calories: ~260 kcal ✅ Protein: ~14 g ✅ Carbs: ~25 g ✅ Fat: ~11 g ✅ Fiber: ~3 g #bananaomelet #healthybreakfast #highproteinbreakfast #healthyfood #recipe
